content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the forecast horizon, especially in the first 5–10 days.
- Overestimates after sharp price spikes (e.g., post-85+), often overshooting by 5–10% and failing to correct quickly.
- Shows persistent downward bias in the middle-to-late forecast window, suggesting mean reversion is not captured well.
- Lags in response to recent price drops — forecasts remain high longer than actuals.
- Tends to overreact to recent volatility, especially when history includes large swings, leading to exaggerated short-term corrections.
- Underestimates the impact of recent high prices on future levels — fails to account for momentum or “price memory” in the model.
